sourceNotes.rawContent:
Elevate your everyday style with this elegant Vintage Anti-Tarnish Gold Bracelet Watch, featuring a sophisticated deep green dial, classic Roman numeral detailing and a sleek rectangular-link bracelet. The combination of the rich green dial and gold-tone finish gives this watch a timeless, luxurious look.
Designed with a jewellery-inspired vintage aesthetic, this watch is perfect for women who love elegant and statement-making accessories. The compact oval-shaped dial and structured bracelet make it easy to pair with both ethnic and western outfits.
Product Highlights
- ✨ Vintage-inspired watch design
- 💛 Anti-tarnish gold-tone finish
- 💚 Elegant deep green dial
- 🕰️ Classic Roman numeral markers
- 🔗 Sleek rectangular-link bracelet strap
- ⌚ Quartz movement
- 💎 Elegant jewellery-inspired appearance
- 👗 Perfect for ethnic and western outfits
- 🎁 Ideal gifting option for women
- ✨ Suitable for everyday wear and special occasions
Perfect For
Office wear, college looks, casual outings, festive occasions, parties, date nights, weddings and gifting.
Care Tip: Keep away from perfumes, water, excessive sweat and harsh chemicals. Store in a dry place when not in use to help maintain the finish.
